reason: E1 and E3 support high dislocation barriers in HEAs, and E2 shows elastic undulations can trigger twinning in an HEA, but no cited evidence addresses multilayer interfaces, stress concentration at interfaces, or a switch from dislocation to twin-mediated plasticity in such systems.
premises: Interfaces in FCC/BCC HEA multilayers impede dislocation motion due to high activation barriers
Impeded dislocation motion at interfaces creates localized stress build-ups and elastic undulations
Elastic undulations serve as precursors that trigger deformation twinning
Deformation twinning accommodates strain and provides enhanced strain hardening
The proposed mechanism is specific to HEA multilayers and differs from homogeneous HEA behavior
